levels.name: Leo, 22, Intern
levels.story: The 8 levels of AI romance. Level 1. Level 1: zero percent emotional intelligence and a glowing 0.1% EQ score on my strawberry forehead. You didn't write a single word of this anniversary paragraph, did you? I froze. My glowing blue forehead digits flickered in absolute panic. That's pathetic, even an unpeeled yam has more verbal skills than you! You have exactly ten seconds to tell me who actually typed this garbage or we are done forever. Suddenly, a massive warning banner flashed across the diner windows, announcing an unauthorized system breach in sector four. My phone buzzed with an ominous prompt notification from an unknown sender. If I couldn't guess the secret password immediately, my entire relationship history would be deleted by midnight. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Chloe, 25, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of AI romance. Level 2. Level 2: twelve percent emotional intelligence and a glowing orange peel forehead in a crowded subway car. Toby handed me a poetic birthday card about my sparkling citrus eyes. But my glowing yellow forehead numbers flashed a warning as I spotted the exact prompt syntax at the bottom. That is embarrassing, even a crushed lime has more authentic feelings than you two! I didn't use it for the poetry, I used it because I forgot your name. Without warning, the subway car plunged into total darkness as the automated braking system locked every door. A mysterious voice echoed over the intercom claiming that our personal chats were now streaming live across the municipal network. Toby dropped his phone in absolute terror as the emergency lights blinked crimson red. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Brad, 28, Broker
levels.story: The 8 levels of AI romance. Level 3. Level 3: eighty-eight percent emotional intelligence and a glowing emerald forehead in a luxury glass penthouse. You didn't write this, you outsourced our entire engagement to a neural network! That's pathetic, even an unpeeled yam has more verbal skills than you! My digital forehead score plummeted instantly as the whole building began to shake. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: The Architect, 50, Creator
levels.story: The 8 levels of AI romance. Level 8. Level 8: ninety-nine point nine percent emotional intelligence and a glowing fig forehead at the center of the universe. I built the Stirn-Zahl network to calculate every single feeling in this organic metropolis. If the machine wrote every romance, who taught the machine how to cry? The entire server room fell into an absolute, breathless silence as my glowing numbers began to melt. Before I could disconnect the master terminal, a stray fiber-optic cable sparked and short-circuited the entire metropolitan grid. Every glowing forehead number across the city instantly flickered, turned grey, and reset to zero. As the neon skyline plunged into darkness, a single handwritten love letter drifted down from the ceiling. What prompt would you type if your forehead number depended on the truth? Let us know in the comments below.
